programme.title: K-CHAT: Travel in Korea
programme.desc: Simple and Fun Korean Lessons, “K-Chat: Travel in Korea” What are the most useful expressions visitors to Korea can use right away?From arriving at the airport to finding your hotel and exploring popular travel destinations, this program offers practical expressions for your Korean language journey. It also covers traditional Korean culture and essential travel information, making it an invaluable resource for beginner to intermediate learners! Discover Korean travel expressions in an engaging and entertaining way with skits performed by ONF’s Hyo-jin, Seung-jun, Wyatt, and Alexa. With clear and accessible explanations from Hye-rim of the Wonder Girls, a graduate of Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, you’ll systematically improve your Korean!

programme.title: Countryside Escape
programme.desc: A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea. Bringing the “chon-cance” trend, which has gained attention among young people and on social media, to television, the show creates a feel-good story of healing and connection that everyone can relate to.※ VOD service is currently not available due to copyright issues.

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: The AI industry has just had the fright of its life. After a shock US midterm election result handed Democrats control of both houses of Congress, the companies leading the AI revolution suddenly face an uncomfortable reality: investigations, subpoenas, public backlash and the prospect of sweeping new regulation. At the very centre of the storm is Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, whose company sits at the heart of the global AI boom. Recent revelations surrounding Huang have triggered a crisis of confidence, wiped hundreds of billions from Nvidia's market value, and raised difficult questions about corporate governance, national security and the concentration of power inside the AI industry. Meanwhile, Elon Musk's political gamble appears to have backfired spectacularly. After pouring hundreds of millions of dollars into the midterms, Silicon Valley's most influential figures are now confronting a Congress that may be far less willing to give them the benefit of the doubt.

programme.title: The Interface
programme.desc: The show that reaches through your screen, to tell you the tech stories that ready matter. Hosted by BBC technology journalist Thomas Germain and social media expert Professor Jessica Maddox, The Interface dives into the stories, trends, apps, gadgets, algorithms and internet obsessions shaping how we live, work, think and connect. From AI and influencers to memes, data leaks, cybersecurity and the weirdest corners of the web, The Interface explores what happens when technology collides with real life. Cutting through the hype, the hosts unpack the platforms, products and online phenomena that increasingly shape our choices, our culture and our sense of self - whether we like it or not! Sharp, insightful and often very funny, The Interface examines our relationship with technology in all its messy, brilliant, absurd and world-changing glory. Along the way, it tackles one of the biggest questions of our age: what kind of future are the likes of Elon Musk, Chat GPT and all the other Silicon Valley giants building, and does anyone really want to live there?

programme.desc: Eric Knowles visits Nottingham’s Gothic revival cathedral to learn how conservators are revealing 19th-century artwork under decades of plaster and paint. Designed in 1842 by architect Augustus Pugin, the cathedral’s interior was whitewashed in the 1960s. Pugin is widely admired for his work on some of Britain’s most famous buildings, including the Palace of Westminster. Conservator Ana Logreira shows Eric how they are using digitally created stencils to renovate the cathedral’s historic interior. At Southwell Racecourse in Nottinghamshire, red team uncle and niece Russ and Lily are up against twin sisters Angie and Tamsin in blue. With just 60 minutes to buy three items, Russ makes an early pit stop at a stall selling boxed toy cars. Meanwhile, a marcasite brooch catches the sisters’ attention, but expert Irita Marriott isn’t convinced it will dazzle the bidders. Trying to hammer out a profit for the teams in Nottingham is auctioneer Hettie Jago, who has her eye on the jewellery among the lots.

programme.desc: In this episode, the experts lend their skills to a community project, hear the story behind a new treasure to be repaired and visit a local crafting hero. York Minster is one of our most magnificent cathedrals, boasting the world’s largest expanse of medieval stained glass. But the stonework of this glorious gothic monument is crumbling away on a daily basis. Will and Dom join the new generation of stonemasons being trained to save it, harnessing modern technology while still using centuries-old skills. Will’s Yorkshire odyssey continues in Cawthorne, where Elwin presents him with a huge drum that has been owned by the local marching band since the 1850s. The damaged paintwork, ill-fitting skins and loose cords aren’t befitting such a magnificent instrument, so percussion expert Pete Woods takes on the mammoth task of getting it back into a playable condition. Dom heads further south through God’s Own Country to visit occasional Repair Shop expert Jonathan Reid in his Sheffield workshop. Here the master putter, or scissor-maker, is keeping the endangered craft of making scissors by hand alive, and he’s eager to share some secrets of the trade with his fellow craftsman.

programme.desc: When Bill’s wife walks out on him for the gardener, he’s left lonely and broke. In the hope of turning his life around, he lets out his spare rooms to four students. Bill is thrilled to meet his new housemates: Christian, Zahra, Hettie, and James. But when Christian keeps leaving the fridge door open, Bill has to come up with a scheme to get it shut without ruining his image as a relaxed, fun landlord. Bill’s best mate, Drew, gives him the idea to deploy an anonymous suggestions box, but this backfires when the students’ requests lead to the worst night’s sleep of his life. Bill’s neighbour and secret crush, Siobhan, suggests sending over her intimidating husband, Martin, to complain on Bill’s behalf, but when this ruse is exposed, Bill fears the students will leave him, just like his wife did. He’s grateful to learn that not only do they have nowhere else to live but they forgive him, since university is all about starting over. For better or worse, his new life truly has begun.

programme.title: Cheers: Wie du mir, so ich dir

programme.title: Cheers: Die Frau fürs Leben

programme.title: Cheers: Beziehungskisten

programme.title: Cheers: Das perfekte Paar
programme.desc: Ein berühmter Eheberater und Studienfreund von Frasier hält sich für kurze Zeit in Boston auf. Bei einem Analyse-Gespräch mit Sam und Diane kommt er zu dem Schluss, dass die beiden nie und nimmer zusammenpassen würden.

programme.title: Cheers: Sams Patentochter
programme.desc: Sam erhält unerwarteten Besuch von seiner Patentochter Joyce. Ganz der fürsorgliche Patenonkel, nimmt Sam seine Pflichten ausgesprochen ernst. Als Aufpasser für Joyce wählt Sam Woody aus. Zu seinem Entsetzen verloben sich die beiden nach kurzer Zeit.

programme.title: Cheers: Wo gehts hier zum Büro des Chefs?
programme.sub-title: Wo gehts hier zum Büro des Chefs?
programme.desc: Norm hat einen neuen Job. Der ist angeblich gut bezahlt. Die Freunde finden heraus, dass er gelogen hat. Wieder einmal entpuppt er sich als Versager. Diane spornt ihn an, endlich mehr Ehrgeiz zu entwickeln. Also versucht Norm sich als Karrierist.

programme.title: Cheers: Cheers – Der Film
programme.desc: Woodys Eltern leben in der Provinz. Sie sehen es nicht gern, dass ihr Sohn den Gefahren der Großstadt ausgesetzt ist. Daher verlangen sie, dass er nach Hause kommt.

programme.title: Cheers: Das Alptraumhaus
programme.desc: Sam und Diane kaufen sich ein Eigenheim. Die Freude an den eigenen Wänden will jedoch nicht aufkommen. Sie lernen die vormaligen Besitzer, ein altes Ehepaar, kennen. Die hängen noch sehr an dem Haus. Deswegen will Diane nun doch nicht einziehen.

programme.title: Cheers: Dianes Abschied
programme.desc: Die Hochzeit von Sam und Diane steht bevor. Da wird Diane, die schon immer Schriftstellerin werden wollte, die Veröffentlichung eines ihrer Romane angeboten. Jetzt ist die Frage, ob Diane ihre Arbeit mit der Ehe verbinden kann.

programme.title: Cheers: Ich bin wieder da!
programme.desc: Nach der Trennung von Diane hat Sam das Cheers verkauft. Er ist auf Weltumsegelung gegangen. Nun ist die Bar nicht mehr, was sie einst war: Die Stammkunden bleiben aus. Zur Freude aller kehrt Sam unversehens zurück. Seine Yacht ist gesunken.

programme.title: Cheers: Der neue Sportreporter
programme.desc: Der renommierte Sportreporter Dave Richards kommt ins Cheers. Er bittet seinen alten Freund Sam um einen Gefallen. Da er für seine Sportsendung ausfällt, soll Sam ihn vertreten. In seiner Eitelkeit geschmeichelt, sagt Sam sofort zu.

programme.title: Cheers: Eine richtige Familie – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carla und Eddie wollen endlich heiraten. Weil sie abergläubisch sind, lässt sich kaum ein einwandfreier Termin finden. Als endlich alle Probleme gemeistert scheinen, treffen Carla und Eddies Mutter aufeinander: eine schreckliche Begegnung.

programme.title: Cheers: Eine richtige Familie – Teil 2

programme.title: Cheers: Der unwiderstehliche Frasier

programme.title: Cheers: Maler im Haus
programme.desc: Norm hat Schulden im Cheers. Um sie abzuzahlen, streicht er Rebeccas Büro. Dabei lernt er sie näher kennen. Er begreift, dass hinter ihrer rauhen Schale ein weicher Kern steckt. Das freundliche Verhältnis zwischen ihnen bleibt auch Sam nicht verborgen.

programme.title: Cheers: Spitzname und andere Frivolitäten
programme.desc: Die Cheers-Truppe hat durch einen Kollegen von Frasier Informationen über Rebecca erhalten: Rebeccas Spitznamen zu ihrer Studienzeit waren ,,Partyhase Nummer eins" und ,,Backseat-Becky".

programme.title: Cheers: Die Wohltätigkeitsveranstaltung
programme.desc: Frasier und Lilith verbringen einen romantischen Abend miteinander. Tollpatsch Frasier bringt es jedoch fertig, die Stimmung zu zerstören: Er erklärt seiner Gattin in spe, dass er einen Ehevertrag aufsetzen wolle. Wütend verlässt Lilith das Cheers.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Woody hegt schon seit langem den Wunsch, Schauspieler zu werden. Er spricht oft vor, wird aber abgelehnt. Da verspricht ihm der Regisseur, dass er im Falle eines Ausfalls einspringen könnte.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Alibimann
programme.desc: Rebecca hat ein Problem: Ihr Chef Drake, den sie heimlich anhimmelt, hält sie für eine Lesbe. Um ihn vom Gegenteil zu überzeugen, muss sie in männlicher Begleitung zu Drakes Party erscheinen. Sam bietet sich unverbindlich an.

programme.title: Cheers: Professor Clavin
programme.desc: Cliff hat sich verliebt. Seine Angebetete Sally ist eine graue Maus. Cliff würde jedoch gerne mit seiner neuen Freundin angeben. So verwandelt sie sich unter seiner Anleitung zu einer schönen Frau. Nun interessieren sich auf einmal etliche Männer für sie.

programme.title: Cheers: Sam als Weihnachtsmann
programme.desc: Die Mitarbeiter vom Cheers sind sauer auf Rebecca. Sie hat alle für den Heiligabend zum Dienst eingeteilt. Dennoch haben alle, außer Sam, ein Weihnachtsgeschenk für die strenge Chefin besorgt. Nun versucht Sam, schleunigst ein Präsent aufzutreiben.

programme.title: Cheers: Affentheater

programme.title: Cheers: Scherben bringen Glück

programme.title: Dunkerk
programme.desc: Uznávaný filmař Christopher Nolan napsal, natočil a zprodukoval tento velkolepý válečný akční thriller. Snímek DUNKERK začíná v momentě, kdy jsou u severofrancouzského města Dunkerk německým vojskem obklíčeny stovky tisíc britských a spojeneckých vojáků. Uvěznění na pláži a s oceánem v zádech, spojenečtí vojáci čelí naprosto bezvýchodné situaci. A německá vojska jsou blíž a blíž. Příběh se odehrává na souši, na moři i ve vzduchu. Spitfiry Královského letectva se pouští do vzdušných soubojů nad kanálem La Manche ve snaze ochránit bezbranné muže pod svými křídly. Mezitím se narychlo sestavená britská záchranná flotila snaží zachránit přes 300 tisíc spojeneckých vojáků v operaci, kterou premiér Winston Churchill nazval "zázračným vysvobozením".

programme.title: Klub rváčů
programme.desc: Když nemůžete půl roku usnout, celý okolní svět vám začne připadat jako nekonečný sen. Všechno kolem vás je nedokonalou xeroxovou kopií sebe sama. Chodíte do práce, díváte se na televizi a jste vděčni za to, když občas ztratíte vědomí a nevíte o světě. Lidí s podobnými problémy moc není, ale mladý úspěšný úředník, který si říká Jack (Edward Norton), je jedním z nich. Má slušnou práci, vydělává slušné peníze, ale trpí nejtěžší formou nespavosti. Na služební cestě se Jack seznámí s Tylerem Durdenem (Brad Pitt), který mu nabídne příbytek pod podmínkou, že mu vrazí pořádnou ránu. Tato "výměna názorů" se oběma zalíbí a brzy vznikne první Klub rváčů. Místo, kde můžou mladí muži, znechucení světem, odložit své starosti a stát se na pár minut zvířaty.

programme.title: Do morku kosti
programme.desc: Ree Dolly je sedmnáctiletá dívka, jejíž otec je nezvěstný a matka trpí těžkými depresemi. Ree se tak musí sama postarat o svou chudou rodinu žijící v drsném prostředí missourské vysočiny Ozark. Když se dozví, že otec dal jejich dům jako záruku za vlastní kauci, musí ho najít dřív, než jim majetek zabaví soud a vyžene rodinu hluboko do lesa. Ree tak poruší tradiční zákon mlčení a riskuje svůj život, čelí lžím, podvodům a výhrůžkám příbuzných, ale nakonec začne krůček po krůčku odhalovat pravdu.

programme.title: Respect: Královna soulu
programme.desc: Film vypráví výjimečný příběh životní cesty legendární hudební hvězdy Arethy Franklin. Svůj hlas musela prosadit v nesnadných 60. letech minulého století, kdy se Amerika ocitla uprostřed bouřlivého sociálního a politického dění. Výběr herečky, která ji měla ztvárnit ve filmu, schválila ještě samotná pěvecká legenda. Kromě držitelky Oscara Jennifer Hudson (2007, nejlepší herečka ve vedlejší roli "Dreamgirls"), se ve hvězdně obsazeném životopisném snímku představí i držitel Oscara Forest Whitaker (2007, nejlepší herec "Poslední skotský král"), zpěvačka Mary J. Blige či Marlon Wayans.

Vše se ale změní, když do laboratoře přivezou obojživelného tvora (Doug Jones), který má armádě sloužit jako pokusný králík. programme.title: The Wire - Špína Baltimoru
programme.desc: S02E03 Bunk s Freamonem pokračují ve vyšetřování nákladní lodi směřující do Filadelfie, nikdo z posádky však nerozumí anglicky. Poručík Cedrik Daniels, znechucený svým přeřazením do oddělení kontroly důkazů, se nechá slyšet, že dá výpověď. Na rozkaz Barksdala najde Bell způsob, jak se zbavit Tilghmana, který stále obtěžuje Wee-Beye. McNulty prověřuje Jane Doeovou, jejíž plovoucí tělo bylo nalezeno v přístavu. Dva z přístavních dělníků, syn Franka Sobotky Ziggy se synovcem Nickem, ukradnou náklad digitálních fotoaparátů, které prodají chlápkovi, co pracuje pro Řeky. D ́Angelo po nepříjemné návštěvě strýčka Avona Barksdala souhlasí, že ve vězení přestane s drogami. Konečně jedno moudré rozhodnutí.

programme.title: The Wire - Špína Baltimoru
programme.desc: S02E04 Sobotka se zlobí na synovce Nicka za ukradené fotoaparáty, chce, aby zastavil celý obchod, ale už je příliš pozdě. McNulty si sám sobě dal za úkol zjistit více o plovoucí mrtvole, ale jeho starý parťák Bunk ho upozorní, že mají na práci důležitější věci.

programme.title: Osvícení

programme.title: Good bye, Lenin!
programme.desc: Říjen roku 1989 nebyl právě nejvhodnější čas pro upadnutí do kómatu, tedy aspoň pro občany Východního Německa. A přesně to se stalo Alexově matce, nadšené zastánkyni socialismu. Když se o osm měsíců později probudí, Alex stojí před velkým problémem. Její srdce je tak slabé, že by ji mohl zabít sebemenší šok. A co by Alexovu matku mohlo šokovat víc, než pád Berlínské zdi a konečné vítězství kapitalismu v jejím milovaném Východním Německu? Aby ji Alex zachránil, udělá z jejich společného bytu ostrůvek minulosti, jakési muzeum socialistické éry, kde si bude jeho matka připoutaná na lůžko užívat milosrdné nevědomosti a žít v přesvědčení, že se nic nezměnilo. Alexovi jeho plán nějakou dobu vychází, ovšem jen do té doby, než se matka začne cítit líp a odhodlá se znovu postavit na vlastní nohy.

programme.title: Vyměřený čas
programme.desc: V tomhle sexy, stylovém akčním thrilleru si zahrál Justin Timberlake a Amanda Seyfried. V budoucnosti, kde jsou doslova čas peníze a stárnutí se zastaví na hranici pětadvaceti let, je jediným způsobem, jak přežít, získat víc času - musíte ho však vydělat, ukrást anebo zdědit. Jenže když je chudý muž z nižší třídy (Timberlake) falešně obviněn z vraždy, spojí se s krásnou dědičkou (Seyfried) a snaží se vymyslet způsob, jak podkopat zkorumpovaný systém, dřív než jim odtikají poslední minuty jejich života!

programme.title: Gravitace
programme.desc: Oscaroví herci Sandra Bullocková a George Clooney se představí ve skvěle napsaném příběhu zasazeném do hlubokého vesmíru v režii Alfonsa Cuaróna (Potomci lidí). Ryan Stoneová je skvělá lékařka/inženýrka a právě zažívá svou první vesmírnou misi. Společnost jí mimo jiných dělá veterán Matt Kowalsky, který naopak svou kariéru astronauta právě končí. Během rutinní práce mimo základnu se však stane neštěstí, díky kterému se dvojice ocitne uprostřed vesmíru s omezenou dávkou kyslíku a s minimální nadějí na přežití. Děsivé ticho jen dokazuje, že jejich spojení se Zemí bylo definitivně přerušeno a že pomoc nemá kam dorazit. Jejich poslední šancí na záchranu je pokračovat do útrob děsivě prázdné temnoty.

programme.title: Kdyby ulice Beale mohla mluvit
programme.desc: Kdyby ulice Beale mohla mluvit, intenzivní milostný příběh o nerozbitném poutu zamilovaného páru, který musí za své štěstí tvrdě bojovat, se odehrává na počátku sedmdesátých let v černošském Harlemu. Jeho vypravěčkou je devatenáctiletá Tish Riversová. Tato dcera a budoucí manželka zde živě vzpomíná na vášeň, respekt a důvěru, která ji spojovala s jejím umělecky nadaným snoubence Alonzem Huntem, jemuž se přezdívá Fonny. Tish a Fonny se spolu přátelí od dětství. Sny o společné budoucnosti se ale rozplynou ve chvíli, kdy je Fonny zatčen a křivě obviněn ze zločinu, který nespáchal.

programme.title: Něžný bar
programme.desc: Snímek režiséra George Clooneyho podle úspěšných memoárů, sleduje úsilí ambiciózního spisovatele (Tye Sheridan) o naplnění jeho romantických a profesních ideálů. Na stoličce v baru svého strýce (Ben Affleck) poznává taje růstu a dospívání od pestré plejády místních postaviček.

programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: V energickém akčním filmu se Rocky utkává se svým dosud nejsilnějším protivníkem - krutým svalovcem jménem Clubber Lang (Mr. T). V možná nejnapínavějším a nejpoutavějším dílu celé série jde Rocky od jednoho vítězství ke druhému, podepisuje lukrativní smlouvy a stává se slavným po celém světě. Když ale "italský hřebec" utrpí potupnou porážku od Clubbera Langa, zdá se, že pomalu ztrácí své výsadní postavení. S pomocí odvěkého rivala Apolla Creeda (Carl Weathers) se Rocky snaží znovu získat bojového ducha, aby se s Langem mohl utkat ve vyčerpávající odvetě o světového šampiona v těžké váze.

programme.title: Muži v černém 3
programme.desc: Agent Jay cestuje v čase zpět do roku 1969, kde se spojí s mladší verzí agenta Kaye a společně se pokusí zastavit ďábelského mimozemšťana dřív, než zničí budoucnost. S třetím dílem snímku Muži v černém se vrací také agent J (Will Smith) a K (Tommy Lee Jones). A vracejí se také v čase! J viděl za patnáct let v tajné službě spoustu nevysvětlitelných věcí, ale co mu vůbec nejde na rozum je jeho zdrženlivý partner. Ovšem když je život agenta K v ohrožení a s ním i osud celé planety, musí J podstoupit dobrodružnou cestu v čase a vše napravit. J zjišťuje, že existují tajemství vesmíru, o kterých mu K nikdy neřekl - tajemství, která vyplynou na povrch, když se J spojí s mladší verzí agenta K (Josh Brolin). Podaří se mu zachránit svého parťáka a osud lidstva?

programme.title: RoboCop
programme.desc: V roce 2028 je nadnárodní konglomerát OmniCorp lídrem v oblasti robotických technologií. Jeho drony jsou už dlouhá léta využívány armádami po celém světě, jen doma v Americe se tato technologie stále považuje za příliš kontroverzní. Alex Murphy jako policista dosahuje vynikajících výsledků v boji s kriminalitou a korupcí v Detroitu. Alespoň do chvíle, než utrpí rozsáhlé zranění. Šílený Max (Tom Hardy), pronásledovaný svou pohnutou minulostí, je přesvědčen, že jediný způsob, jak přežít, je vydat se na osamělou pouť. programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: Near what's known as the hanging tree, the mutilated body of Timothy Coggins is found in late 1983. The investigation is thwarted and the case freezes for over 30 years, until a newly elected sheriff vows to bring the killers to justice.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Manchas delatoras
programme.desc: La policía instituyó una búsqueda intensa cuando la madre de dos niños pequeños desapareció.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una mujer desaparece sin dejar rastro. A pesar de que se sospecha de un juego sucio, las pistas no funcionan y la investigación se estanca.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Paintball
programme.desc: En 1962, la gente de la pequeña ciudad de Hanford, California, perdió la sensación de paz cuando una de las vecinas, Marlene Miller, de 15 años, fue asesinada.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un asesinato brutal, muchos sospechosos y pruebas contradictorias, pero los forenses fueron claros en una cosa: el asesino conocía a su víctima. Y eso les dio a los investigadores una ventaja.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Los residentes de Noel, Missouri, se sorprendieron al enterarse de que su banco había sido asaltado y el presidente del banco había desaparecido.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Tracey Frame, de 35 años, fue condenada por el asesinato de David Nixon en Abril del 2002 después de que él había planeado terminar su relación.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: ¿Quién fue el delincuente sexual que asesinó a dos muchachos adolescentes en Nebraska? La clave para detenerlo sería la composición única de la cuerda basura que usó para amarrar a sus víctimas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando una estudiante universitaria desaparece, sus compañeros de clase estaban preocupados por la seguridad de ella y la de ellos.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un joven sano muere misteriosamente mientras duerme y las pruebas de toxicología revelan una dosis letal de lidocaína en su sangre.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2002, una pequeña comunidad en el norte del estado de Nueva York quedó devastada cuando Patty Wlasiuk murió en un accidente de camión.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En la búsqueda del asesino de dos adolescentes de Texas, un perfil de conducta llevó a sospechar de Jason Massey. La ciencia demostró que el perfil era correcto y Massey fue ejecutado mediante inyección letal el 3 de Abril del 2001.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La escena del crimen estaba inundada de sangre, lo que hablaba del horror del crimen: el asesinato de dos niños pequeños y el apuñalamiento de su madre.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El 12 de Mayo de 1994, Crystal Perry fue asesinado viciosamente en su casa en Bridgton, Maine. Michael Hutchinson, de 32 años, fue encontrado culpable del asesinato.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Este episodio documenta un atentado mortal en una iglesia en Oakwood, Illinois, en diciembre de 1997.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Muere un atleta de secundaria, luego de que lo atropellaran y se dieran a la fuga. Todos en el pueblo lamentaron su muerte. Encontrar al asesino era muy poco probable.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El cuerpo de una atractiva joven fue encontrado a una milla de su auto abandonado.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Rompecabezas de plástico
programme.desc: Un hombre que iba en bicicleta resultó herido de muerte y la policía creía que había sido víctima de un accidente de atropello y fuga.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1985, Julie Estes fue secuestrada de una tienda de conveniencia en Southside donde trabajaba. Su cuerpo fue encontrado al día siguiente, pero el asesinato quedó sin resolver hasta el 2003.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un policía retirado es descubierto en su cama, muerto de una sola herida de bala en la cabeza. Su esposa primero dice que el motivo fue un robo; luego le dice a la policía que se suicidó.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1991, Dorothy Donovan fue asesinada en su casa de Dover, Delaware. Cuando su hijo declaró que fue asesinada por un polizón que la había recogido, la policía se mostró escéptica.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un oficial de policía de Alaska encontró el cuerpo de una mujer mientras patrullaba de rutina un parque público.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En el año 2000, Judy Southern llegó a casa del trabajo y recibió un disparo de un hombre armado que esperaba dentro. Su esposo llegó poco después, llamó a los servicios de emergencia y la llevó al hospital.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1984, los bomberos de California habían combatido diez incendios provocados en tres semanas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Los investigadores examinan las cenizas de un incendio que mató a una mujer de 40 años. El fuego parecía haber sido iniciado por un cigarrillo desatendido.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando la casa de un policía se incendia, los expertos sospechan de un incendio provocado. El oficial cuya casa fue incendiada arresta al narcotraficante de bajo nivel James Wren, quien confiesa.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Edward Honaker fue declarado culpable de violación, sodomía y agresión sexual agraviada y condenado a tres cadenas perpetuas en prisión. El sostuvo su inocencia.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Sometimes, when a man and a woman unite, a terrible urge for destruction can awaken in them both. Happy couples become deadly teams, intent on one goal: murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women are more often prey than predators, but the exceptions are deadly women indeed. In this episode, we’ll discover what drove these deadly women to prey on the unsuspecting.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While their sisters chose a life of sensible, suburban motherhood, these deadly women chose a life of crime. They lived with the thrills, the danger and the deadly consequences of being outlaws.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Married to Murder
programme.desc: To the outside world, their marriages seemed happy. But behind closed doors, there was no domestic bliss. These women wanted out, but getting a divorce wasn’t their preferred option.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: No one doubts a woman’s capacity to love, but sometimes lust can turn lethal. In the ultimate fatal attraction, "Deadly Women" looks at cases of murder driven by obsessive love.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Judi Buenoano secretly murdered lovers to claim on insurance policies whilst nurse Genene Jones secretly killed at least 46 infants left in her care between 1980 and 1982.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women never get their hands dirty: no blood touched them because they manipulate others to kill for them...but they didn't get away.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Under His Control
programme.desc: These are love stories with bleak, bloody endings. Blinded by desire, obsessed and malleable, some women fall into lethal relationships with dangerous, controlling men.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Blood ties are strong ties, sometimes strong enough to pull a person into a murderous conspiracy. When a family member wields his or her power, the result can be death.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Obsession
programme.desc: Deciphering what causes minds to corkscrew out of control is the complex work of the criminal profiler. Obsessions can take many forms: beauty, devotion, ego and power.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love Gone Wrong
programme.desc: Love can be beautiful, love can be blind and love can be deadly. Desire and jealousy are powerful forces driving women to dark and horrifying places in their minds.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Teen Killers
programme.desc: They were too young to drink or vote but they were not too young to commit the most brutal of crimes. Some were driven by pure curiosity: how would it feel to take a life?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Crimes of revenge are usually single acts of passion. A brew of hatred and restitution boils over in a manic moment of fury. Once caught, revenge killers usually display remorse and atonement.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The path towards revenge can sometimes lead to murder. It can be quick, fiery and violent. It can also be a dish served cold, the product of a calm, calculated plot.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Up on the Roof
programme.desc: Today, Dog and the family are back in Colorado and are about to make one of their most exciting captures ever. When the adrenaline-fueled arrest goes down, every family member will play a critical role.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Family Business
programme.desc: Dog and the Chapman clan start their hunt today with another well-established bail bonding family. As Dog's fame has grown, so have his responsibilities.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Felons Interrupted
programme.desc: Dog is confronted with two alleged felons in crisis. Family and friends of these bondees are convinced that they are getting into further trouble while awaiting trial, so Dog and the posse have to bring these men back to jail.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Let It Snow
programme.desc: Christopher is barely 21, already has a history of domestic abuse and assault, and is facing major time in a room without a view. This hunt won't be easy for Dog - the leads are few, informers and family are not forthcoming.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rush from Judgment
programme.desc: Facing hard time for forging checks, Melissa pulled a vanishing act at her sentencing hearing, bolting from the courthouse in broad daylight. Lucky for her bondsman, Dog and his posse are in Colorado and ready to help.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Burn & Return
programme.desc: Dog is busy. First, he's after a fugitive who is allegedly an expert in the game of "burn and return"- shoplifting goods to return them for cash refunds. But he's not easy to track.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Stormy Weather
programme.desc: Going after two fugitives in one day is tough enough without the facing Colorado's notoriously unpredictable weather. Today, it's the threat of severe thunderstorms, hail and area wide tornado warnings.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: One for the Money
programme.desc: It hurts Dog to see people who after years of walking the straight and narrow, suddenly lose their way. But today's case is a member of the law enforcement community who has recently gone astray, and that truly troubles the Dog.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Reality Check
programme.desc: Dog is back in Denver and in hot pursuit of a woman wanted for identity theft. The sad reality is that the identify which has been robbed is her own. She's traded in a bright future for a life on the wrong side of the law.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: No Piece of Cake
programme.desc: Being hunted by the Dog is a lousy way to celebrate your birthday but that's exactly the spot that Robert finds himself in today. He's missed his court date, quit his job, and vacated his last known address.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Prayers and Mace
programme.desc: Both brother Tim and fellow Honolulu bondsman James need Dog's help to track down their hard to find fugitives. The two cases on the docket today are challenging, especially the hunt for Gregory, a felon with a lengthy rap sheet.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: New Dog in Town
programme.desc: It's Beth's birthday and Dog knows just what she needs. He surprises Beth with Delilah, a puppy small enough to sit in the palm of her hand. Beth is so happy that she insists on taking the puppy with her on today's bounty.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Trick or Treat
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and before Dog and Beth can help the kids carve their pumpkins, they have some business to attend to. It involves knocking on doors and meeting the neighbors but instead of hunting for treats they're on the search for a fugitive.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Girl Trouble
programme.desc: Dog and the team have girl trouble in this case. Krystal jumped bail and seems to have vanished into the high plains of Colorado. To make matters worse, she's running with her lover (and bond co-signer) Carrie. But Thelma and Louise they ain't.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Seeing the Light
programme.desc: Today Leland and Dog make a quick visit to the police supply store to get some new gadgets for the team but they can't linger because they've also got a fugitive to catch. Their target is reputed to have an explosive temper.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: When a Stranger Calls
programme.desc: When an offender with a long record ducks his day in court, Bobby Brown knows whom to call - The Dog!? And knowing that few souls can resist Beth's clever persuasion, Dog gives her the job of luring the fugitive in.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Jack & Jill
programme.desc: Today's case is a twofer, a brother and sister both charged with drug related offenses. Also, Dog has crossed paths with the brother before. He once tried to stop Dog from arresting one of the most violent fugitives of his career.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Island Hopper
programme.desc: When a brother bondsman from Washington State calls Dog for help tracking a runner in search of fun in the sun on the tropical paradise of Kauai, the team gets on the case. Dog's only problem? No leads!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Nice Guys Finish Last
programme.desc: Dog and team help out a bondsman friend whose client jumped bail, but the target is a blank slate. Are his tattoos gang related? Is he likely to be violent? And making matters worse, when they hit his apartment they learn he is moving out.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Back Behind Bars
programme.desc: While tracking down a potentially dangerous ex-con facing a five year stretch in the big house, Leland struggles to find time to train and compete for his first boxing match in years.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Family Man
programme.desc: Dog and family head to Kona to track down a wanted father who's looking to bolt to the mainland to evade sentencing. Meanwhile, Dog does some evading of his own - Avoiding the much dreaded birthday party!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: All in the Family
programme.desc: Dog and the team need to help Leland hunt down some elusive fugitives. The case is a family affair with both mother and daughter in trouble with the law.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mother Courage
programme.desc: Dog knows that crime and drugs not only damage victims but also harm the families of the perpetrators, especially the kids. And both of the fugitives he's chasing today have left shattered families and struggling women in their wake.

programme.title: Ty Barnett
programme.desc: Ty Barnett, a Chicago native, got his start at Seattle's Comedy Underground. Whoopi Goldberg called Ty “hilarious” and reviewers have said he is “thought provoking” and “edgy”. All this praise earned him many television appearances. He hosted the Food Network's Mealin' and Dealin', Discovery Family's Babies Behaving Badly and Beasts Behaving Badly, and appeared in over 15 national commercials. It all began when he was one of the two finalists on the most-watched and Emmy nominated season of Last Comic Standing. Ty went on to multiple Tonight Show appearances where Jay Leno called Ty “one of the funniest comedians working”. He also appeared in HBO's Bad Boys of Comedy, his own Comedy Central Presents and one-hour special Issues. Ty was named “one to watch” by the Hollywood Reporter. He's also been seen on the sitcoms Samantha Who, Til Death, Life in Pieces, NickMom Night Out and Tosh.O. His comedy album, Grown Man-Baby Steps is a favorite on Sirius XM.

programme.title: Phil Kopczynski
programme.desc: Phil Kopczynski is a reluctant nice guy and father who just wants to occasionally play in the wilderness and regularly make city-dwellers laugh.

programme.title: Karen Rontowski
programme.desc: Karen Rontowski's fast-paced, quirky and charmingly optimistic comedy has been featured in clubs, TV, radio, and at corporate events all around the world. Her stand- up showcases endearing, self-effacing and intelligent characters that catch you by surprise every time. Karen uniquely blends comedy with her experience as a Paranormal Investigator and Reiki master. From fun with her family to her travels all over this great country Karen has fun where ever she goes. Her lighthearted confusion entertains kids of all ages. She is fascinated with the “afterlife” is convinced she will someday have a near death experience because, “I never finish anything.” She explains, “Sometimes a ghost will just do the same thing over and over in life. That's why I want to move into a house that is haunted by a maid." Karen's comedy is now featured in the new line of greeting cards called “Frank and Funny” sold at Target stores everywhere and is the comedy writer for “Haunted Magazine.” She is a regular on the Bob and Tom Radio Show and is a featured performer on their CD. Karen has appeared on The Late Show with David Letterman, Sirius Satellite Radio, Comics Unleashed, Comedy.com, Live at Gotham and Comedy Central. She has opened for show biz legends including Bob Hope, Ray Charles, David Brenner and the Monkees.

programme.title: Joe Devito
programme.desc: Joe DeVito's dead-on timing and unexpected twists make him a favorite at comedy clubs across the USA. His TV appearances include The Late Late Show, Last Comic Standing, Comedy Central, Comics Unleashed, and AXStv's Gotham Comedy Live. He's also a regular on TV news panels, finding the funny in pop culture and current events. Joe's albums First Date with Joe DeVito and Three's Comedy are in regular rotation on SiriusXM radio.

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: Dwayne returns to Dry Bar Comedy. If you loved his first special, you will certainly love his 2nd! Dwayne Perkins has earned a spot in today's elite class of stand-up comics with appearances on Comedy Central and on Conan.

programme.title: Dwight Slade
programme.desc: Winner of this year's "Boston Comedy Festival." Part man, part ageless boy comedian Dwight Slade has the privilege of being a comedy legend in American stand up. The winner of this year's Boston Comedy Festival, Slade combines an intelligent, raging voice of justice with the snickering attitude of a high school prankster. He gives the impression of a man on a journey. Who enjoys nothing more than making fun of everything along the way. Born in Seattle, Dwight moved often in his early years, living in San Mateo, California Wilton, Connecticut Marietta, Georgia and Houston, Texas.

programme.title: Myles Weber: Pug Life
programme.desc: Opening his set by describing himself as a series of white dudes, Myles Weber hones in on the humor of his life experiences in his special, joking about growing up in the hood, playing The Green Lantern in an amusement park, and his three-legged pug Taz.

programme.title: Chad Thornsberry
programme.desc: Chad Thornsberry was born in St. Louis, MO. From an early age he learned his family was blessed, and blessed him with humor, quick wit, and a love of storytelling. Chad's unique comedic perspective awards audience the opportunity to laugh at the common occurrences in everyday life. Often referred to as a great writer, his straightforward style allows audiences to laugh with him and at him as they find the humor in themselves. With reflections on growing up in a trailer park and observations as an English teacher, Chad's satiric insights look at the pitfalls that make us human. With smart humor and a conversational style, Chad has delighted audiences from the trailer park, throughout the Midwest, and from coast to coast.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E07 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: XTERRA Adventures
programme.desc: S01E07 XTERRA is the world's premier off-road multisport event. An extreme competition, the XTERRA format combines swimming with mountain biking and trail running. It has been described as one part triathlon, one part mountain bike race, and one part "survival of the fittest". The typical distances are a 1.5k swim, 30k mountain bike, and 10k trail run.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race - 2019
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense 'flash stage', featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km "finisher" stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo's unforgettable single-track...

programme.desc: Business rivals Miranda and Paul unknowingly meet at a Santa themed fancy-dress party. But will their feelings towards each other alter when their identities are revealed? Stars Travis Nelson. 2021

programme.title: The Mistletoe Promise
programme.desc: 2016 Romance starring Jaime King. Two Christmas haters agree to navigate the season together - but with the magic of the season beginning to take hold, will love also be on the cards?

programme.title: A Family For The Holidays
programme.desc: Sequel to 'Finding Father Christmas'. Miranda is exited to return to Vermont and spend Christmas with Ian and her long-lost family. But will a chance meeting threaten her future happiness? 2017

programme.title: Christmas in the Air
programme.desc: Robert, a widower and father of two children, enlists Lydia to help him juggle his chaotic work-life balance at Christmastime. Will their close relationship lead to love? Stars Catherine Bell. 2017

programme.title: Welcome To Christmas
programme.desc: 2018 Festive romance with Eric Mabius. Developer Madison visits Christmas, Colorado, for a ski resort development plan but finds community and holiday magic. Will progress threaten the town's charm?

programme.title: If Only We Had Christmas
programme.desc: 2020 Festive romance starring Candace Cameron Bure. When a publicist teams up with a cynical VP to help a charity in need, will a surprise revelation put paid to their promising romance?

programme.title: A Christmas Switch
programme.desc: 2018 Struggling singer Audrey loves Christmas, but wealthy record executive Julie just sees it as another reason to shop. The two women have nothing in common until a freak accident strikes.

programme.title: A Date By Christmas
programme.desc: 2019 Christmas romance with Vanessa Lengies. When the dating app she created grants her magical powers, can Chelsea use her abilities to help the 'naughty' people in her life onto the nice list?

programme.title: A Christmas Mission
programme.desc: 2020 Festive romance with Mary Antonini and Michael Xavier. Emma is reluctant to come home for Christmas despite her General dad's wishes. Can an old flame back from active duty change her mind?

programme.title: Deliver By Christmas
programme.desc: 2020 Romance with Alvina August and Eion Bailey. Baker Molly is charmed by town newcomer Josh and a customer she's only met by phone. But do her suitors have more in common than she thinks?

programme.title: A Christmas To Cherish
programme.desc: 2019 Heartwarming holiday drama with Peter Porte. A couple preparing to celebrate the perfect Christmas together must swap the fireside eggnog for a fight to save the beloved local community centre.

programme.title: Forever Christmas
programme.desc: A workaholic reality TV producer starts working on a new show about a sexy guy who celebrates Christmas every day, she finds herself falling for her mysterious new star. Starring Chelsea Hobbs 2019

programme.title: A Storybook Christmas
programme.desc: 2019 Christmas romance with Ali Liebert. When event planner Celeste calls in help to give her niece the perfect Christmas, will the nanny agency's unexpected choice be perfect for her too?

programme.title: Hearts Of Christmas
programme.desc: 2016 Romance with Emilie Ullerup. A doctor planning a surprise Christmas party clashes with the hospital's new CFO, who is determined to trim the budget instead of the tree - until Cupid scrubs in.

programme.title: Django Meets Sartana
programme.desc: The small desert town of Black City is held in a reign of terror by a nasty gang of criminals lead by the ruthless Bud Willer.

programme.title: Cry Blood Apache
programme.desc: Gang of sadistic cowboys let nothing stand in their way in their search for gold.

programme.title: Flaming Frontier
programme.desc: Old Surehand and his loyal companion Old Wabble hunt a ruthless killer known as “The General,” who murdered Surehand’s brother. Their quest draws them into growing tensions between settlers and the Comanches. With the help of his blood brother Winnetou, Old Surehand must face both personal vengeance and the threat of war.

programme.title: Degueyo
programme.desc: When Ramon's bandits storm Danger City for rumored treasure, they slaughter or capture the men, leaving only women and children to face a ruthless "Deguello" if the money isn’t found. Four determined men, already hunting Ramon, join forces to help the town defend itself.

programme.title: Two Crosses at Danger Pass
programme.desc: Judy and Alex are the only two survivors of a punitive mission ordered by the rich and ruthless Moran.... The girl becomes his maid and the boy is adopted by a Quaker family. Alex, despite the philosophy of forgiveness he has been taught, plans to take revenge.

programme.title: Companeros!
programme.desc: A Swedish arms dealer and a Mexican peon team up to rescue the intellectual leader of the Revolutionary cause, while taking part in numerous misadventures along the way.

programme.title: Trinity in Eldorado
programme.desc: Con artists Jonathan and Sebastian roam the West seeking easy riches. When magic elixirs and card tricks fail, they target the eccentric Eldorado. Recruiting Ringo Jones and enlisting Eldorado’s niece Juanita, they plot the heist - but with so much at stake, can trust survive among them?

programme.title: Buddy Goes West
programme.desc: Two outlaws, "The Doctor" and the Indian Girolamo, help a village fight a gang and a corrupt sheriff who has discovered gold beneath the town.

programme.title: The Desperado Trail
programme.desc: After the Civil War, renegade Rollins and his gang stir conflict between settlers and Native Americans. Apache chief Winnetou and his friend Old Shatterhand try to preserve peace, but Winnetou is framed for the murder of Chief White Buffalo’s son using his own knife. Old Shatterhand must uncover the truth and clear his friend’s name.

programme.title: Two Brothers in Trinity
programme.desc: After inheriting a land plot in a dusty place called Trinity, the antagonistic half-brothers, Lester and Jesse, reunite to pursue different aspirations, only to find themselves neck-deep in trouble. Will they ever fulfil their dreams?

programme.title: A Few Bullets More
programme.desc: Billy starts as an innocent outlaw protecting his mother but soon becomes a ruthless killer. Yet fate drags Billy back into violence, and Garrett is ultimately credited with his death.

programme.title: iCarly: Schluss mit lustig – Teil 2
programme.desc: Bei iCarly ist ein ziemlich cooles Video eingetrudelt. Die Macher heißen Fleck und Dave und sind obendrein auch noch sehr witzig, weswegen Carly und Sam sie in die Show einladen.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibby flippt aus
programme.desc: Tasha, Gibbys Freundin, bittet Freddie um einen Ratschlag, da sie Gibby eine Videokamera zum Geburtstag schenken möchte. Als die beiden deshalb alleine oben im iCarly Studio sind, stolpert Tasha und fällt auf Freddie.

programme.title: iCarly: Alte Liebe, neuer Horror
programme.desc: Sam findet im Büro des Portiers Lewbert eine Kiste mit persönlichen Gegenständen. Als sie diese zusammen mit Carly und Freddie durchstöbert, finden die Drei eine romantische DVD, die von Lewberts Ex-Freundin Marta erstellt wurde.

programme.title: iCarly: Miss Teen Seattle
programme.desc: Sam outet sich als ehemalige Teilnehmerin bei Misswahlen. Um zu verhindern, dass ihre frühere Widersacherin Leanne Carter die hundertste Misswahl in Folge gewinnt, simuliert Sam einen Wutanfall und zwingt Carly dazu, bei der Wahl zur Miss Teen.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly für Daddy
programme.desc: Sam hat einem Diplomaten einen Chilidog in die Hose gestopft und landet im Knast. Doch Carly will die wöchentliche iCarly auf keinen Fall absagen, da ihr Vater zum ersten Mal live zugucken kann. Sie überredet Spencer, für Sam einzuspringen.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly im All
programme.desc: Mr. Blanton, ein stinkreicher Mann, bietet iCarly die Möglichkeit, ins All zu fliegen. Sie sollen von dort aus eine Webshow senden. Doch zuvor müssen sie ein Trainingswochenende absolvieren und ihre Konkurrenten, eine Fitnessshow, aus dem Weg räumen.

programme.title: iCarly: Bigfoot und Waschbiber
programme.desc: In einem Nationalpark wird immer wieder der sagenumwobene Bigfoot gesichtet. Carly glaubt fest daran, dass es ihn wirklich gibt, aber die anderen sind eher misstrauisch.

programme.title: iCarly: iPsycho – Teil 2
programme.desc: Die 'iCarly'-Truppe beschließt auf dem Weg zu einer Web-Konferenz, einen kurzen Abstecher zum Geburtstag eines einsamen Fans zu machen.

programme.title: iCarly: Pleiten, Pech und Patzer
programme.desc: In dieser Folge gibt es die besten Outtakes, Versprecher, Patzer und Lachanfälle aus 70 Folgen 'iCarly'!

programme.title: iCarly: Hurra, hurra, die Bude brennt!
programme.desc: Spencer versucht, Carly an ihrem Geburtstag zu überraschen, aber stattdessen setzt er ihr Zimmer in Brand. Doch als ihm die Versicherungsfirma einen dicken Scheck aushändigt, hat er die Chance, alles wiedergutzumachen.

programme.title: iCarly: Ja, ich will
programme.desc: Als ein Fan von iCarly seiner Freundin in der Web-Show live einen Heiratsantrag macht, erklärt sich die Truppe bereit, zur Hochzeit zu erscheinen. Doch als die Braut kalte Füße bekommt, muss Carly den Tag retten.

programme.title: iCarly: Penny-Tees
programme.desc: Die Truppe steigt ins T-Shirt-Geschäft ein. Als die Penny-Tees zum Verkaufsschlager werden, rekrutiert Sam Viertklässler, die bei der Herstellung der Shirts helfen sollen. Doch Carly, Sam und Freddie streiten sich wegen der Arbeitsbedingungen.

programme.title: iCarly: Der König der Streiche
programme.desc: Carly gesteht, dass sie noch nie im Leben jemandem einen Streich gespielt hat. Um zu beweisen, dass sie es dennoch kann, bittet sie Spencer um Hilfe. Doch der hat damit ein gewaltiges Problem.

programme.title: iCarly: Sams Mom
programme.desc: Nach einem Streit mit ihrer Mutter zieht Sam bei Carly ein. Aber Carly merkt schon bald, dass Sam ein schrecklicher Gast ist. Freddie wird von einem gefährlichen Kriminellen gestalkt, nachdem er ihn bei einem Verbrechen gefilmt hat.

programme.title: iCarly: Armer Nevel
programme.desc: Als ein Video von Nevel im Internet kursiert, in dem er ein kleines Mädchen zur Schnecke macht, wird er zum Hassobjekt der Leute. Er fleht Carly und ihre Gang darum an, seine Ehre wieder herzustellen – und die lassen sich tatsächlich dazu erweichen.

programme.title: iCarly: Zu doof, um wahr zu sein
programme.sub-title: Zu doof, um wahr zu sein
programme.desc: Carly und Co. wollen ein wenig von der vielen Arbeit abtreten und suchen deshalb nach Praktikanten. Bei der Vorstellungsrunde tut sich besonders ein vielversprechender Nerd hervor.

programme.title: iCarly: Krieg der Fans – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly ist völlig in Adam verknallt. Doch als dieser sie endlich zu einem Date einlädt, muss sie schockiert feststellen, dass ausgerechnet zu dieser Zeit ein großer 'iCarly'-Auftritt auf einer Comic-Messe ansteht.

programme.title: iCarly: Krieg der Fans – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly ist völlig in Adam verknallt. Als Carly dann Adam dazu einlädt, sie auf eine Comic-Messe zu begleiten, ahnt sie allerdings noch nicht, dass sie in einen äußerst peinlichen Fan-Krieg verwickelt werden wird.

programme.title: iCarly: Und zum Schluss ein Kuss
programme.desc: Carly und ihre Freunde verbringen eine Nacht in der Schule, um ihre Schulprojekte abzuschliessen. Dabei glauben Carly und Freddie, dass sich Sam möglicherweise in den neuen Jungen namens Brad verknallt haben könnte.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty With Victorious – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly und Tori finden heraus, dass sie sich beide mit dem gleichen Typen treffen – und die erzürnten Mädchen holen natürlich sofort zum Gegenschlag aus.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty With Victorious – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly und Tori finden heraus, dass sie sich beide mit dem gleichen Typen treffen – und die erzürnten Mädchen holen natürlich sofort zum Gegenschlag aus.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty With Victorious – Teil 3
programme.desc: Carly und Tori finden heraus, dass sie sich beide mit dem gleichen Typen treffen – und die erzürnten Mädchen holen natürlich sofort zum Gegenschlag aus.

programme.title: iCarly: Es gibt Zoff!
programme.desc: Carly muss ständig zwischen Freddie und Sam vermitteln.

programme.title: iCarly: Die Liebe und der Wahnsinn
programme.desc: Carly findet heraus, dass Sam sich in eine Nervenheilanstalt hat einweisen lassen, weil sie glaubt, wegen ihrer Sympathie für Freddie verrückt zu sein. Da sie nicht aus der Anstalt herauskann, fragt sich die Gang, wie sie sie herausbekommen.

programme.title: iCarly: Das Nerd-Camp
programme.desc: Als Gibby einen Plan ausheckt, um Sam und Freddie zu trennen, deckt Mrs. Benson deren Beziehung auf. Wird sich Carly für Sam und Freddie einsetzen oder Gibby dabei helfen, sie auseinander zu bringen?

programme.title: iCarly: Zu dumm
programme.desc: Carly will ihren neuen Schwarm damit beeindrucken, indem sie sich schlauer gibt als sie eigentlich ist. Währenddessen hilft der Rest der Truppe T-Bo dabei, ein neues zu Hause zu finden, weil er aus dem 'Groovy Smoothie' geschmissen wurde.

programme.title: iCarly: Besuch der First Lady
programme.desc: Die Kids wollen Carlys Vater eine Online-Geburtstagsparty schmeißen. Doch als sie sich in ein gesichertes Netzwerk einhacken, bekommen sie Ärger von einer wichtigen Informationsagentur des Landes.

programme.title: iCarly: Psycho-Nora kehrt zurück – Teil 1
programme.desc: Die iCarly-Kids erfahren, dass Nora Dershlit aus dem Knast freikommen soll. Was können sie tun, damit ihre ehemalige Peinigerin hinter Gittern bleibt?

programme.title: iCarly: Psycho-Nora kehrt zurück – Teil 2
programme.desc: Die iCarly-Gang muss einen Weg finden, vor Nora und ihren verrückten Eltern zu fliehen.

programme.title: iCarly: Im Butterkuchen-Himmel
programme.desc: Alle außer Carly gehen zur Kanadischen Kuchenfabrik, doch Sam darf nicht wieder in die USA einreisen. Unterdessen macht sich Carly ausgehfertig für ein Date.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "India: Can Kolkata be considered a foodie destination of India?"
programme.sub-title: India: Can Kolkata be considered a foodie destination of India?
programme.desc: Liesel pinballs around a city known for its gastronomy, the forgotten hub of British East India trading company, Kolkata. From trying out what the bustling city’s vibrant street food scene has to offer, to the lesser known gems, including, venturing into India’s only Chinatown and sampling their delicacies. A tale of walking food tours, hole in the wall joints serving up North Eastern dumplings, messy fish markets, and of course, the pride of Bengal, the Hilsa fish. Is Kolkata up to par with the other major metropolitan cities of India? This episode finds out exactly that!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Nevada: What else is there in Nevada for foodies besides Vegas?"
programme.sub-title: Nevada: What else is there in Nevada for foodies besides Vegas?
programme.desc: This investigative mission starts off in the sin city atmosphere of the Vegas strip. After a gluttonous stint at a generic buffet, Liesel is inspired to do a road trip to find iconic gems in the state of Nevada. From ghost towns, to monstrous foodie challenges, to hole in the wall dive bars in the middle of nowhere, this trip has it all. Liesel finds the resurgence of Basque cuisine in Northern Nevada, and learns that Reno can do fine dining as well! A trip to Virginia city also reveals that the Silver State has some haunted bars where patrons from the 1800s are rumored to be still imbibing and spooking locals! It’s a road trip in every sense of the word!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1 - "Rome: What are the tourists missing out on?"
programme.sub-title: Rome: What are the tourists missing out on?
programme.desc: Italy is a vacationer’s paradise. The food, the people, the sights and sounds, the history! But are the tourists doing it right when it comes to the trying out authentic food in Rome? Liesel embarks on a mission to explore the street food of the city. With the help of her food journalist buddy, Saverio de Luca, Liesel sifts through pasticceri, food festivals, touristed hotspots, all in an effort to understand real Roman food.

programme.title: м/с Рейнджер Лео и дикая природа 2 ┊ 47
м/с Рейнджер Лео и дикая природа 2 ┊ 48
м/с Томас и его друзья 17 ┊ 7
programme.desc: По серии книг «Железнодорожные серии» Уилберта Одри и Кристофера Одри. Паровозик Томас живет и работает в огромном депо на острове Содор. Томас с радостью выполняет разные поручения: подготавливает вагоны к долгому пути с большими паровозами, отгоняет пустые вагоны, чтобы освободить место. Он – настоящий трудоголик и следит за тем, чтобы коллеги не ленились. Его товарищ, заносчивый большой паровоз по имени Гордон, совершает длительные рейсы с пассажирскими и грузовыми вагонами, после которых любит вздремнуть. По причине своего характера он часто попадает в сложные ситуации, но на помощь ему приходят маленькие паровозы Томас и его друг Эдвард. Обязанности этих двух паровозиков очень похожи, но машинисты часто жалеют Эдварда, любящего перевозить людей, и разрешают ему тоже совершать рейсы с пассажирами. Он очень трудолюбивый и отлично справляется с любыми задачами, боясь не оправдать надежды взрослых. Генри – большой паровоз, обожающий свой зелено-красный цвет, поэтому больше всего на свете боится его испортить и поцарапать себя. Приключения постепенно сближают товарищей, и они становятся настоящими друзьями. Вместе они выполняют важные поручения и исследуют мир, доставляя вагоны во множество городов… Реж: Дэвид Миттон, Стив Эскуит, Грег Тирнан и другие, В ролях: Марк Мораган, Майкл Анджелис, Ринго Старр; Бен Смолл, Джон Хэслер, Мэтт Уилкинсон, Тереза Галлахер, Стивен Кинман, Найджел Пилкингтон, Боб Голдинг, Кит Уикхэм, Уильям Хоуп, Тим Уитнолл. programme.title: м/с Рейнджер Лео и дикая природа ┊ 50
м/с Робокар Поли и его друзья 2 ┊ 6
programme.desc: В небольшом городке Брумс бок о бок живут машины и люди. Полицейский автомобиль Робокар Поли трудится на местной спасательной станции. Его коллегами являются: Роботрак Рой, Робовэн Эмбер, Робокоптер Хэлли и девушка-диспетчер Джин. Робокар – лидер спасательной команды. Он любит патрулировать Брумс. Рой – пожарный грузовик, гроза огня и самый сильный в отряде. Благодаря сменному шасси он может выступать в роли подъёмного крана. Добрая и отзывчивая Эмбер – машина медицинской помощи, всегда подберет нужные слова, чтобы утешить и ободрить попавших в беду. Джин сообщает спасателям, где требуется их присутствие, а шустрый вертолёт Хэлли помогает координировать действия команды. В критических обстоятельствах Поли, Рой, Эмбэр и Хэлли умеют превращаться в роботов. В Брумсе возникают не только происшествия, но и различные проблемные ситуации, требующие вмешательства спасателей, а чтобы в дальнейшем инцидент не повторился, Поли и его друзья всегда готовы дать хороший совет. Реж: Джун Ён Ом, В ролях: Марк Томпсон, Айлин Стивенс, Кэйт Бристол, Ребекка Солер, Джейсон Гриффит, Джо Уайатт, Дэвид Уиллс, Майк Поллок, Лиза Ортис, Даррен Данстан, Сюзи Майерс, Джессика Пакет. Южная Корея, 2011, приключения

programme.title: Pakistan Tonight
programme.desc: Pakistan Tonight with Adil Nizami is a show well known for covering events as they happen.

programme.title: 3 Way Poly
programme.desc: A young couple's experiment in intimacy spirals into a nightmare when they invite a seductive stranger into their home. Little do they know, she's a killer on the loose, and their lives hang by a thread

programme.title: Three Secrets
programme.desc: Struck with the grief after losing her child, Naomi is stuck in a depression while her husband begins to stray from their marriage. Hoping to bring life back into their boring marriage, he invites her to go out with him and they meet a mysterious woman who joins them for the evening. As events unfold She finds herself in an unexpected entanglement built on lies.

programme.title: Trapped in the Game
programme.desc: Polo is a young desperate hustler looking to make some quick cash. However, the only way he knows how to make cash quickly, is pimping out young women with the help of his crew. When of his crew starts taking girls off the street, the heat threatens to bring down his whole operation.

programme.title: My Man
programme.desc: Trina, a young model, becomes entangled with the charming Max. As their relationship deepens, she uncovers his dark secrets: a double life, a psychotic ex-girlfriend, and a dangerous obsession. When Trina crosses a line, she becomes the target of a deadly game of cat and mouse. Betrayal, madness, and murder ensue as the lines between love, obsession, and survival blur.

programme.title: ToxiCity
programme.desc: Corey Spencer, the innovator behind the successful ATLUV dating app, navigates a complex personal life. Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order. A night out leads him to Sierra, an alluring actress who quickly moves in. Their romance sours as Sierra's past as a dancer and her aggressive jealousy come to light.

programme.title: Contusion
programme.desc: Terry and his grandmother enjoy a life of peace and harmony, until one night when a group of thieves invade their home. As he navigates from the aftermath, he must confront whether justice will prevail or whether darkness will consume everything he holds dear.

programme.title: Your Man Will be Mine
programme.desc: Fed up with her neglectful boyfriend Cory, Raina seizes a golden opportunity when he’s arrested by stealing his bail money and vanishes. Seeking refuge with her cousin Jessica, Raina’s survival instinct takes a dark turn as she is tempted by Jessica’s boyfriend, hoping to secure a new life. But when Cory unexpectedly busts out of jail and comes hunting for his cash, Raina must choose love or survival.

programme.title: Baddies Revenge
programme.desc: After discovering her NFL-star boyfriend proposed to another woman live on television, Sierra turns her heartbreak turns into rage. She brings in her closest friends who have suffered betrayals of their own and begin to target the men that destroyed them emotionally.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF
programme.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: Deadly Surrogate
programme.desc: When a young married couple suffer the pain of infertility, they look to the path of surrogacy and come upon Alana as a potential candidate. As the three become intertwined, tensions begin to unravel and threaten to consume them.

programme.title: Mistress for Hire
programme.desc: Skylar works as a professional mistress hired by women for divorce leverage. When she finds herself falling for her target, Eric, she questions her career and her motives. But when Eric’s wife, Octavia, won’t allow Skylar to destroy her plans, and a dangerous game of cat and mouse ensues, with love and survival on the line.

programme.title: Heart of a Woman
programme.desc: Alisha, a rising model with a bright future, chose to put her career on hold to stand by her football star husband Jax. When an opportunity arises for her to return to the runway, their marriage is put to the test, and whether love or career holds the most weight in their relationship.

programme.title: Don Dada
programme.desc: Desperate to survive a brutal Chicago winter, Rah Jah and Tee Tee hustle for food and shelter in the streets. When a botched deal lands him in the hands of powerful crime bosses, he rises to the top of the hierarchy at a deadly cost.

programme.desc: When the boss of Calders Biscuit Company is murdered in Copenhagen, Barnaby and Nelson join forces with two female Danish detectives, the abrasive and astute Poulsen and the charming and cool Degn.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Midsomer is buzzing with excitement at the arrival of the annual Paramount Dance Extravaganza.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Prolific real estate agent Alexander Beauvoisin is murdered in front of a crowd.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The Deddingtons thriving bee Empire has put Granville Norton on the map.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Fishermen and women flock to catch a giant fish that is said to lurk in the lake.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Midsomer Deverell are angered over plans by the Inkpen family to convert the public memorial garden into a tea shop. When Elspeth Inkpen's daughter 'Fliss' is found murdered in the garden, shortly after a village meeting, Barnaby and Troy suspect that someone may be determined to stop the destruction. As their investigations continue, they discover a web of snobbery, greed, illegitimacy and mourning.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Gregory Chambers, manager of the Easterly Grange Hotel, goes missing just before the funeral of Karl Wainwright, his employer, after venturing into the woods to collect wild mushrooms. His wife tells everyone, including the police, that nothing is untoward. During a search of the woods, a severed hand is found. The case becomes more complex when the beneficiaries of Wainwright's will start receiving death threats.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Not only do Midsomer Parva's wheat fields include crop circles, they also contain an added mystery element, when the naked body of a dead man is found. It is later discovered that he was first electrocuted, has puncture marks on his back, and a chunk of his hair missing. Barnaby and Troy have their work cut out with rivalries, secret affairs and loves, jealousies and hatred.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village doctor of Newton Magna involves the police after he accidentally hits a man in the road following a party; however, the injured man is nowhere to be found. Then the body of Robin Wooliscroft, who disappeared over a year before, is pulled up from a well. The detectives come up against suspicions, lies, disapproving families, resentments and hidden secrets before another victim is found and they get to the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the remote hamlet of Goodman's Land, local postman and casanova Dave Cutler gets murdered whilst doing his early postal delivery. Barnaby and Troy, with WPC Jay Nash, start investigating. They discover Dave had slept with many women in the village. A witness later recalls having heard strange 1950s dance music before the murder. When others become victims to the killer, the detectives need to find a possible link to connect the murders before Jay gets into a perilous situation herself.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Malham Bridge, eccentric widow Isobel Hewitt and adulterous doctor Duncan Goff are both murdered while fly fishing near the riverbank. DCI Barnaby and DS Troy question if one or the other was the target and whether one just happened to stumble across the other. Many suspects and motives abound, as the detectives try to find out. When another murder takes place, Barnaby deduces that it may have been a distraction to conceal the killer's identity.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The body of Martin Wroath is found in his home in Midsomer Worthy. From first appearances it looks as though he had committed suicide by shotgun. Evidence soon suggests that he was murdered. When a second murder takes place on the grounds of the cottage hospital, the detectives need to uncover any possible connections to link the deaths, as well as the mysteriously disappearing rope.

programme.desc: Po nepríjemnom stretnutí so staromódnou kráľovskou rodinou si George nechcene vymení miesto s namysleným kráľovým opičiakom Phillippe. programme.title: Barbie Thumbelina
programme.desc: Barbie predstavuje príbeh Malenky v moderne prerozprávanej klasickej rozprávke. Zoznámte sa s drobným dievčatkom menom Malenka, ktorá žije v harmónii s prírodou v magickom svete. Z rozmaru rozmaznaného dievčaťa menom Makena prídu Malenka a jej dve kamarátky o svoj záhon divokých kvetín a skončia v luxusnom apartmáne v meste. Tam sa dozvedajú o stavebnom plánu, ktorý hrozí zničeniu krajiny. Malenka osedlá prírodnú mágiu a dokáže, že aj ten najmenší človek môže niečo veľké zmeniť.

programme.title: Denníček Barbie
programme.desc: Barbie je úplne obyčajná gymnazistka z periférie, ktorá vo voľnom čase najradšej muzicíruje so svojimi kamarátkami, Tiou a Courtney. programme.title: Barbie - magický delfín
programme.desc: V tomto zábavnom podmorskom dobrodružstve Barbie a jej sestry navštívia Kena na jeho letnej stáži, kde na korálovom útese skúma delfíny. Pri potápaní a objavovaní útesu sestry objavia vzácne, dúhovo sfarbené delfíny, ktorí priplávajú len raz za rok. Tento úžasný nález ich povzbudí k pátraniu, ako ochrániť koralový útes a všetok jeho morský život. Vtedy stretnú Islu, tajomnú novú kamarátku, ktorá je tiež na výprave za záchranou koralu. To, čo sa zdá byť ľahká úloha, sa zvráti v dobrodružstvo, keď vyjde najavo, že Isla je vlastne morská panna. Ale nie je čas sa radovať, že majú za kamarátku morskú pannu, pretože Isla potrebuje pomoc Barbie a jej sestier i vzácnych delfínov, aby zachránila situáciu.

Sie stehen für Emotion und Power - und für Autos, die einmalig sind. Die 100-Prozentige Mercedestochter ist eine Paradefirma des großen Stuttgarter Autobauers. programme.desc: Audi Q3 Weltpremiere - 1. Staffel, Folge 104: Audis wirtschaftliche Lage ist angespannt. Kosten müssen runter ¿ Gewinne müssen hoch.
